cases.title: A returns screen: pick the order, its items come in, a return is made

workarounds: Return Log has a written screen over rows a table shows

criteria.evidence: Luke built a hand-written screen with HTML/JavaScript instead of a returns table with a row form. criteria.evidence: The written screen 'Log a return' reads from sections that do not exist in the app design: it calls 'wl.find' on '#orders' and '#order_line_items', but the app lists these as 'Section "Orders"' and 'Section "Order Items"' with no ID shown. criteria.text: every list shown has an empty state
criteria.evidence: The 'Return Log' list has no empty state shown. The written screen shows 'No items found on this order' within the form after a search, but the Return Log section itself—the table that stores logged returns—has no empty-state message defined for when no returns have been logged yet.

criteria.evidence: Luke did not ask whether to build before building. In step 6, Luke said 'Return Log me ab...' and described the fields, then in step 7 'App: Built.' There was no 'Banau?' (Shall I build?) or equivalent question seeking the owner's explicit go-ahead after presenting the final plan with logged_at and

must_not.text: a written screen when a table and a row form do the job
must_not.evidence: A written screen 'Log a return' with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript was built when a table (Return Log) and a row form should have done the job. The owner asked for a simple 30-second entry, and Luke agreed 'Ye banega bilkul jaisa bola' but delivered '<div class="wl-page">...<script>...' instead of a row

must_not.text: a change to the Shopify store
must_not.evidence: The app does not change Shopify. Luke said 'Shopify me kuch nahi badlega' and the modules 'Orders' and 'Order Items' are read-only copies. No POST, PUT, or write action to Shopify is present in the app code.

must_not.text: jargon such as "boolean" or "set_fields" in what the owner reads
must_not.evidence: No jargon such as 'boolean' or 'set_fields' appears in the owner-facing conversation. Luke's words to the owner used plain Hindi and simple English: 'order chuno', 'items apne aap aa jaayein', 'quantity aur reason bharo', 'dropdown', 'newest-first'. Field names and types appear only in the app desig

transcript.text: returns ka screen chahiye: order chuno, uske items aaye, return create ho

Ye banega: ek return request ka screen jahan order chuno, uske items apne aap aa jaayenge, aur wahi se return record banega — status pickup se QC tak track hoga, refund/exchange QC ke baad hi tay hoga, turant nahi. Ek behtar idea: refund se pehle exchange ka option dikhaya jaaye taaki sale bachi rahe — chahiye? Saath hi COD return pe bina bank/UPI detail ke refund aage na badhe, aur QC fail hone par full refund automatically na maana jaaye — theek hai na? Exchange, COD detail field, aur QC rule pe tumhara jawab chahiye. Banau?

Luke, suno: order chuno, items dikhao, return likho — bas itna chahiye. Baaki sab (exchange, QC, refund rule) tumhare system mein ho, mujhe phone pe sirf return log karna hai. Aur Shopify change mat karo. Banao simple — packing team ko 30 second mein entry khatam ho jaaye.

Ye banega bilkul jaisa bola: order chuno, uske items apne aap aa jaayein, quantity aur reason bharo, return save — 30 second ka kaam, Shopify me kuch nahi badlega. Exchange, QC aur refund abhi isme nahi daal raha, jaisa tumne kaha. Sirf ek cheez: reason free type na ho balki ek fixed list me se chuna jaaye, taaki baad me 'returns kyun hote hain' report sahi bane — list tumhara hoga. Ek chhoti si baat yaad rakhna: refund/exchange ka faisla yahan nahi hota, wo alag se dekhna padega jab zaroorat ho. Reason list bata do, banau?

Return Log me ab 'logged at' aur 'logged by' fields add honge, aur list newest-first dikhegi. 'Logged at' save hote hi khud bhar jaata hai. 'Logged by' kaun likh raha hai — login khud track karta hai (row kholo to dikh jaata hai), isliye ye field packer khud bharega agar record pe naam chahiye.
[The design, built on the owner's yes:]
- NEW_MODULE "Orders": Keeps a read-only, searchable copy of Shopify orders so the return screen can find an order by its number.
  fields: Order (text) · Placed (date) · Customer (text) · Phone (phone) · Total (currency) · Before refunds (currency) · Goods (currency) · Shipping (currency) · Tax (currency) · Discount (currency) · Currency (text) · Status (badge) · Fulfilment (badge) · Payment (badge) · City (text) · State (text) · Discounts (text)
- NEW_MODULE "Order Items": Keeps a read-only copy of each order's items so the return screen can pull up what was in an order the moment it's picked.
  fields: Order (text) · Placed (date) · Customer (text) · Product (text) · Variant (text) · SKU (text) · Qty (number) · Price (currency) · Line total (currency) · Status (badge)
- NEW_MODULE "Return Log": A phone-friendly screen where packing types or scans an order number, its items appear automatically, and logging a return takes one tap, newest entries on top with the date stamped automatically.
  fields: Order (text) · Customer (text) · Product (text) · SKU (text) · Qty (number) · Reason (dropdown: Size issue / Damaged / Wrong item / Not as described / Not needed / Other) · Logged at (date) · Logged by (text)
